newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Stals says pros and cons in appreciating rand.
newsitem.headline: Stals says pros and cons in appreciating rand.

text.p: South African Reserve Bank Governor Chris Stals told reporters on Tuesday there were advantages and disadvantages in an appreciating rand.
"There are advantages and disadvantages in any movement in the exchange rate," Stals said.
"Appreciation certainly helps us to reduce inflationary pressures in the economy, but an appreciation of the exchange rate can create problems for our exporters, for example gold producers," he said.

Stals said the authorities would leave it to the markets to find an exchange rate with which they felt comfortable, but he said the very rapid rise in the currency may have been a little overdone although the level of the currency itself was not excessive.

"The very sharp appreciation of the rand over the past six weeks was perhaps a little bit overdone. I don't really feel that the level of the exchange rate is overdone or that we should not have further appreciation, but I think one needs more gradual adjustments," Stals said.
